title: #0190 — Systemwide — Ctrl+Alt+D Show Desktop aka Minimize all Windows

rules.description: #0190 — Systemwide — Ctrl+Alt+D Show Desktop aka Minimize all Windows (Ctrl-Alt-D)

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'activate application "Finder"' -e 'tell application "System Events"' -e 'set visible of processes where name is not "Finder" to false' -e 'end tell' -e 'tell application "Finder" to set collapsed of windows to true'
